title: How to Run AI Models Locally With Ollama and LM Studio - Agentic Times | AgentLocker

facts.fact: Open-weight AI models trail the best closed models by about four months on average, according to Epoch AI's May 29 analysis.
facts.quote: Open-weight AI models now trail the best closed models by about four months on average.

facts.fact: Paid chatbot subscriptions cost about $20 a month, while the free local tools Ollama and LM Studio cost nothing.
facts.quote: Paid chatbot subscriptions cost about $20 a month, while these tools cost nothing.

facts.fact: LM Studio recommends at least 16GB of RAM on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or newer.
facts.quote: LM Studio recommends 16GB or more of RAM on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or newer.

facts.fact: On Windows, LM Studio recommends 16GB of RAM and 4GB of dedicated VRAM.
facts.quote: On Windows, it recommends 16GB of RAM and 4GB of dedicated VRAM.

facts.fact: LM Studio does not support Intel-based Macs.
Small local AI models need about 8GB of VRAM.
facts.quote: Small models need about 8GB of VRAM.

facts.fact: Heavier local AI users may want a graphics card with 24GB or more of VRAM.
facts.quote: Heavier users may want a graphics card with 24GB or more

facts.fact: Ollama lists Gemma 4 downloads ranging from about 4.6GB to 20GB.
facts.quote: Ollama lists Gemma 4 downloads from about 4.6GB to 20GB.

facts.fact: OpenAI says the gpt-oss-20b model needs 16GB of memory.
facts.quote: OpenAI says gpt-oss-20b needs 16GB of memory, and gpt-oss-120b runs within 80GB.

facts.fact: LM Studio's documentation says the app can operate entirely offline if the user first gets model files.
facts.quote: can operate entirely offline, just make sure to get some model files first.
